# `drive.folder_remove`

Stop learning from a registered Drive folder. Stored evidence remains until reextract or explicit erasure.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice drive-folder_remove`
- **MCP tool:** `drive_folder_remove` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder_id` | `str` | required | The registered Drive folder id |

## Examples

```
operator-voice drive-folder_remove --folder-id <id>
```

## Errors
